_comment: Extension -> suggested source colourspace for the interpret pass. Edited via the minColor shell. 'working' means identity/no effect. 'video709' is the CONTAINER sentinel: it resolves to the family's 709-video space (Linear: Gamma 2.4 Encoded Rec.709, Display: Rec.1886) and fires only when detection/harvest found nothing - tagged media always wins. Other unlisted extensions are skipped and reported, never guessed.
